summary.text: Lisa Post is a Republican member of the New Hampshire House of Representatives from Hillsborough 42 and is on the ballot for re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A small business owner, she previously worked in the presidential scheduling office during the Reagan administration.

paragraphs.text: Lisa Post's career experience includes working as an executive assistant in the presidential scheduling office during the presidency of Ronald Reagan, for Fortune 500 companies, and for public and private nonprofit schools, and as a small business owner.
Ballotpedia lists her as assuming office on December 7, 2022.
Post's 2023-2024 committee assignment was the Commerce and Consumer Affairs Committee, and in 2021-2022 she served on the Resources, Recreation and Development Committee.
